ticket.title: Living Ornament: reusable organic pattern visual
ticket.body: Create a separate animated visual inspired by the second reference painting. Preserve the existing Living Painting. Deliver five batches: remove the arbitrary graph node ceiling; complex shapes and first visual; pattern vocabulary; artistic orchestration and continuous motion; controlled structural transformations. User approved implementation, parallel independent lanes, and one integrated review/publication cycle per batch. Evaluate actual Lux images and animation for varied silhouettes, localized complexity, nested forms, bold boundaries, coherent motif families, density/rest, warm/cool anchors and stable temporal identity. Iterate material artistic defects before publication. Each child includes review, validation, Library publication and merge; no separate stage tickets.

ticket.title: Remove the arbitrary component-count ceiling
ticket.body: Allow larger authored compositions without an arbitrary node-count ceiling. Remove count restrictions consistently from compiler, runtime admission and saved-scene control snapshots; examine adjacent fixed graph quotas so the failure does not simply move. Retain cycle detection, valid resource provenance, byte/time/resource protections and actionable errors. Demonstrate a real scene with more than eight connected components, controls, save/reopen and failed-edit preview retention. Verify the original painting stays visually identical. Update/install authoring skills. One integrated review and merge. Needed now for the multi-pattern Living Ornament scene.

ticket.title: Living Ornament batch 1: shape language and first visual
ticket.body: F01-F06, initial F15/F16. Expand Organic Regions with stable region contract, mixed lobes/corridors, deep bays, thin necks, localized contour complexity, nesting and fitted boundaries. Expand Organic Boundary Ink with bold/colored double edges; Composition Phrasing and Animated Watercolor with anchors, quiet areas and shape-aware washes. Create separate Living Ornament scene with grouped controls. Parallel lanes: geometry, ink, composition/color after minimal contract agreement. Actual flat-color/outline visual must show substantially different shape families, calm and intricate contour stretches and legible large composition. Artistically inspect and iterate before adding pattern detail. Preserve existing Library behavior. One integrated review, publish compatible component updates, save, commit and merge.

ticket.title: Living Ornament batch 2: complete pattern vocabulary
ticket.body: F07-F12. New Spiral Fill, Packed Circles & Rings, Membrane/Petal Divisions, Nested Contours and Decorated Ribbons; expand Region Hatching. Parallel lanes: spirals/circles; membranes/contours; hatching/ribbons. Stable per-region variation, fitted spacing, light/dark reversals and per-family controls. Demonstrate narrow/concave/large regions at multiple scales in one scene. Spirals pack varied sizes; circles retain gaps; membrane hubs form unequal curved petals; contours respect necks; ribbons support beads/stripes/ladder cells. Review actual composition and detail together, fix artistic/clipping issues, publish independent Library parts as one batch, save, commit and merge.

ticket.title: Living Ornament batch 3: artistic orchestration and motion
ticket.body: F13-F20 completing F15/F16. Expand Region Styles & Split Transitions for stable motif assignment, quiet regions and neighbor-aware contrast; Organic Regions for coherent deformation; every pattern for attached/flowing/growing modes; Decorated Ribbons for growth and spacing; Composition Phrasing and Animated Watercolor for delayed local tension/release and migrating warmth. Parallel lanes: shape motion, pattern/ribbon motion, art direction/color. Integrate finished animated Living Ornament. Inspect sustained motion and paused full/detail frames: persistent identity, no accidental texture sliding/reseeding, deliberate density/rest, no uniform pulsing, readable warm/cool anchors. Iterate artistic defects. One batch review, Library updates, scene save/reopen, commit and merge.

ticket.title: Living Ornament batch 4: structural transformations and polish
ticket.body: F21. Expand Organic Regions with occasional neck closure, region division and island creation; expand Region Styles & Split Transitions with parent/child identity and gradual daughter color/motif inheritance. Parallel geometry and style lanes after event contract agreement; independent regression/performance checks. Preserve uneven patches and deliberate timing, avoid popping or continuously unstable topology. Inspect events before/during/after and sustained animation, iterate visual/artistic defects. Demonstrate complete final scene, controls, save/reopen and invalid-edit retention. Publish reusable updates, independent batch review, commit and merge. Preserve original painting and saved values.
